subject: [PATCH v3 02/12] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch as an improvement and applied his Acked-by tag.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch refactors the khugepaged code to correctly count collapses made by the daemon, ensuring that the shared path does not interfere with the daemon's own counter. The change involves modifying the collapse_single_pmd function to increment the khugepaged_pages_collapsed counter only when the daemon is involved in a successful collapse.
